title: Accountant
description:
BPO Hive runs managed B2B appointment setting campaigns for clients in the US and the GCC. We are hiring our first dedicated accountant to own the numbers end to end and build the financial structure this company needs as it scales.

What we are looking for
Qualified accountant with three to five years’ experience, ideally in services or outsourcing
Real cost and management accounting, not bookkeeping alone
Someone who wants to build a finance function rather than inherit one
Fluent English and Arabic
